name: 退役营地避风棚

tool_arguments.prompt: Create one original horizontal 3:2 pixel-art environment style-study image, an unoccupied low-magic medieval place. Use a fixed elevated three-quarter view, nearly orthographic, no dramatic perspective, no horizon or cinematic depth of field. Use deliberately clear chunky pixel clusters, crisp stepped contours and modest grouped shading; each material should read through a few broad muted tones before texture. Restrained weathered brown wood, grey stone, earthy ground and sparse dull olive grass. Keep generous readable ground and uninterrupted paths, with roughly one third of the composition quiet open ground or water. The main landmarks must remain immediately legible at a reduced viewing size. Do not fill every surface with grain, speckles, photoreal microtexture or painterly scratches. No smooth realistic rendering, 3D render, soft antialiasing, blur, glow, modern equipment, characters, creatures, UI, captions, readable writing, numbers, arrows or overlaid grid. Opaque complete scene, no alpha, no collage, no split panels. This is a visual proposal for an original place, not a playable map and not a reproduction of a specific Stoneshard screenshot. Show a small windbreak shelter at the edge of a retired camp, modest and civilian in scale, without a military parade ground. Place the low timber lean-to toward the upper-left half, backed by a short rough grey-stone edge and coarse faded taupe cloth that blocks wind on the back and one side. Keep the front and one side open so the interior reads clearly. Beneath it show a dry quiet conversation area: two simple empty sitting places spaced apart, one modest low table, ample clear ground between them. On a small protected shelf show ONE closed plain canvas document pouch only, its contents completely hidden and unreadable; it is only a possible storage prop, not proof that a diary and a live witness document both exist. A broad uncluttered earthen return footpath runs from the open side of the shelter through the center toward the lower-right frame edge, continuing visibly out of view toward an offscreen waystation. Do not draw the waystation or invent a direct world-coordinate link. Sparse dull grass and a few weathered stones frame, never block, the route. No people, guards, monsters, weapons display, royal flags, triumph banners, imprisonment, restraints, corpses, farewell scene, family reunion, delivered letters or open documents. Nothing implies surrender, relocation, death or consent. Do not substitute an unloading or medicine warehouse: no medicine racks, cargo stacks or hauling ruts.

source_visual_observation: 官方截图可见稳定俯斜镜头、木石粗布和宽土路；旧27/58纹理密度较高，仅参考材料，不继承其布局与细纹理。

selection.reason: 草石密纹显著减少，溪水木桥移除，保留会谈与连续干土地退路；仍有像素颗粒不统一。

derived_outputs.preview_768.png: 等比1/2 nearest缩小，仅供小图检查
derived_outputs.presentation_zh.png: 完整原图等比布局，加中文标题与状态；不绘制或修补场景
derived_outputs.presentation_v2_zh.png: v2完整原图1:1排版+中文标题状态

known_limitations: 草石为大块像素，棚和家具线条更细，视觉像素颗粒不一致；不能称原生像素风格已通过。
单闭合小包仍可能被理解为普通捆包；不能凭外形认定内容为文书，内容隐藏无泄漏成立。
请求384×256底稿4倍视觉仅风格描述，不是实际网格或工具输出尺寸；实际输出1536×1024。
地图比例、瓦片、遮挡、碰撞与游戏实现未做。

revision_v2.reason: Parent visual review classifies dense microtexture as failure of core coarse-cluster style requirement; remove unsupported water/bridge and clarify satchel.

tool_arguments.prompt:
Edit the supplied original scene style-study. Preserve its core layout: one small low half-open timber windbreak lean-to in the upper left, rough grey-stone rear edge, faded taupe coarse-cloth rear and side windbreaks, two empty simple conversation seats with one small low table, a single closed plain canvas document satchel on the protected small left shelf. Make that ONE satchel a clearly flat rectangular flap-closed canvas pouch, not a rolled blanket or bedroll. Its contents must remain entirely hidden with no readable marks. Keep the shelter front and right side open and the conversation area dry. Preserve the broad return route from the shelter through the center to the lower-right frame edge. Remove the entire river and wooden bridge: replace them with quiet dry earthy ground and the uninterrupted earthen return footpath running visibly out of frame. This is a small retired-camp edge, not a military camp, warehouse, village, or medicine unloading depot.

Most important correction: redraw the entire scene in genuinely coarse, clearly grouped pixel-art language. Treat an approximately 384 by 256 logical pixel drawing enlarged fourfold by nearest-neighbor as a visual style reference ONLY, not a technical output claim. Use far fewer and much larger flat pixel clusters, strongly stepped contours, and at most two or three broad shades per stone, wood piece, and cloth panel. Use simple solid grouped grass clumps separated by large smooth quiet earth areas, not individual blades. Keep roughly one third of the composition calm and minimally textured. Eliminate fine speckles, scattered single-pixel noise, fine grain, realistic shrubbery, tiny rock chips, micro-dither, painterly or photographic textures, continuous-tone shading, and detailed foliage. All pixels should be visually chunky, crisp and readable when reduced; no antialiasing or blur. Do not merely apply a pixel filter to the existing dense image: simplify and REDRAW its shapes and material grouping. A few grouped angular stones and sparse dark olive grass frame the route without blocking it.

Fixed elevated three-quarter nearly orthographic camera, stable parallel axes, subdued weathered brown wood, grey stone, dry earth brown and dull olive green. Original horizontal 3:2 composition with complete opaque background. No new structures, people, monsters, corpses, weapons display, flags, royal crests, altar, magic crystals, readable writing, UI, labels, arrows or grid. No surrender, restraint, relocation, reunion, delivered letters, open documents or implied consent. No new narrative result or world-map coordinate link. This remains an unapproved visual style proposal, not a playable map. Output one image only.
